earnings.title: MASCO CORPORATION REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS
highlights: Net sales increased 3 percent to $1,966 million; net sales increased 4 percent excluding our divestiture and currency
Earnings per share were $1.17; adjusted earnings per share grew 23 percent to $1.19 per share
Net sales increased 3 percent to $1,966 million; in local currency and excluding our divestiture of Bristan, net sales increased 4 percent
Plumbing Products’ net sales increased 4 percent; in local currency and excluding our divestiture, net sales increased 5 percent
In local currency, North American net sales increased 5 percent

quotes.text: Our strong third quarter results reflect the strength of our teams, the disciplined execution of our strategy, and the resilience of our business.
quotes.by: Masco’s President and CEO, Jon Nudi

outlook: Expect 2026 earnings per share in the range of $4.51 - $4.61 per share, and on an adjusted basis, $4.65 - $4.75 per share

items.heading: Our business strategy is focused on residential repair and remodeling activity and, to a lesser extent, on new home construction activity, both of which are impacted by a number of economic and other factors.
We may not achieve all of the anticipated benefits of our strategic initiatives.
We may not be able to successfully execute our acquisition strategy or integrate businesses that we acquire.
Variability in the cost and availability of our raw materials, components and finished products could impact our results of operations and financial position.
We are dependent on suppliers and service providers.
There are risks associated with our international operations and global strategies.
